source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, Calls (rules 1.13, Skeleton 2.0): the nine gamma skills' speech actions in a fight. Every number is provisional (spec section 14).

rules.text: A Call is something you say to one unit that can hear you. It costs 2 AP, reaches 4 tiles + 1 per point of its skill, and never deals damage. More points make it better: step 2 of its effect at 3 points, 1 AP instead of 2 at 5 points, step 3 at 7 points, a helping Call usable as a reaction for 0 AP once a round at 9 points (a hindering one only on your own turn), and the first Call of each turn free at 10 points. Each round a unit can be the target of one helping Call and one hindering Call. An enemy saves against 12 + your strength with the Call's skill (its points − 1). A Silenced unit can't Call. AP from a Call arrives this turn if the ally has not acted yet this round, and on their next turn if they have; nobody gains more than 3 AP in a turn or goes above 9 AP.

items.name: Order
items.text: Order an ally to do one thing right now. They do it on their reaction and it costs them no AP. You choose what they do, and it is never an attack.

steps.text: An ally reloads, stands up or picks up a pile right now. It uses their reaction and costs them no AP.
An ally reloads, stands up, picks up a pile or moves right now. The move goes as far as 1 AP walks them, to a tile you pick. It uses their reaction and costs them no AP.
An ally does two different things right now: reload, stand up, pick up a pile, or move as far as 1 AP walks them. Both use the one reaction and cost them no AP.

items.name: Rally
items.text: Give an ally AP. They get it this turn if they have not acted yet this round, and on their next turn if they have.

steps.text: An ally gains {=steps.0.numbers.ap} AP: this turn if they have not acted yet this round, on their next turn if they have.
An ally gains {=steps.1.numbers.ap} AP and loses {=steps.1.numbers.pressure} Pressure. The AP comes this turn if they have not acted yet this round, on their next turn if they have.
An ally gains {=steps.2.numbers.ap} AP and loses {=steps.2.numbers.pressure} Pressure. The AP comes this turn if they have not acted yet this round, on their next turn if they have.

items.name: Brief
items.text: Make an ally's next actions cost less AP. The discount lasts until the end of their next turn, and an action that costs no AP doesn't use it up.

steps.text: An ally's next action costs 1 AP less. This lasts until the end of their next turn.
An ally's next two actions cost 1 AP less each. This lasts until the end of their next turn.
An ally's next action costs 2 AP less, and the one after it 1 AP less. This lasts until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Name It
items.text: Tell an ally, or yourself, what they are facing, so it can't get into their head. They get a bonus on all their saves until the start of your next turn.

steps.text: You or an ally gets +{=steps.0.numbers.saves} on all saves until the start of your next turn.
You or an ally gets +{=steps.1.numbers.saves} on all saves until the start of your next turn, and rolls a new save right now against one condition they have.
You or an ally gets +{=steps.2.numbers.saves} on all saves until the start of your next turn, rolls a new save right now against one condition they have, and stops being Shaken and Afraid.

items.name: Cue
items.text: Give an ally one more reaction. They must use it before the start of your next turn.

steps.text: An ally gets one more reaction, to use before the start of your next turn.
An ally gets one more reaction, to use before the start of your next turn. Or name a free tile next to them: they step there at once instead, for no AP and without provoking an opportunity attack.

An ally gets one more reaction, to use before the start of your next turn, or steps at once to a free tile you name next to them (no AP, no opportunity attack). If you Call on your own turn and they have not acted yet this round, they also take their turn straight after yours.

items.name: Spot
items.text: Point out an enemy to your allies. There is no save. The mark lasts until the start of your next turn and is used up when an ally attacks that enemy; you can't use it yourself.

steps.text: The next ally to attack this enemy ignores its cover. There is no save, and you can't use the mark yourself. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

The next ally to attack this enemy ignores its cover and can target it even if it is Hidden. You can Spot a Hidden enemy if you can see its tile. There is no save, and you can't use the mark yourself. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

The next two allies to attack this enemy ignore its cover, get +{=steps.2.numbers.hit} to hit and can target it even if it is Hidden. You can Spot a Hidden enemy if you can see its tile. There is no save, and you can't use the mark yourself. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Warn
items.text: Warn an ally about the next weapon attack on them. Just before it is rolled they step out of the way, for no AP and without provoking an opportunity attack: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. An attack that can no longer reach them is wasted. The warning lasts until the start of your next turn.

steps.text: Just before the next weapon attack on an ally is rolled, they step 1 tile out of the way for no AP: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. An attack that can no longer reach them is wasted. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

Just before the next weapon attack on an ally is rolled, they step up to {=steps.1.numbers.tiles} tiles out of the way for no AP: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. An attack that can no longer reach them is wasted. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

Just before the next weapon attack on an ally is rolled, they step up to {=steps.2.numbers.tiles} tiles out of the way for no AP: to a tile you named, or else to the nearest tile that gets them clear. That attack is at {=steps.2.numbers.hit} to hit, and it is wasted if it can no longer reach them. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Threaten
items.text: Frighten an enemy. It makes a Heart save against 12 + your strength with Intimidation. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds and loses AP on its next turn.

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds and loses {=steps.0.numbers.ap_loss} AP on its next turn.
The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds, loses {=steps.1.numbers.ap_loss} AP on its next turn and can't move toward you on that turn.
The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Shaken for 3 rounds, loses {=steps.2.numbers.ap_loss} AP on its next turn and can't move toward you on that turn.

items.name: Taunt
items.text: Goad an enemy. It makes a Heart save against 12 + your strength with Insinuation. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you.

steps.text: The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you.
The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you, and that attack costs it {=steps.1.numbers.attack_ap} AP more.
The enemy makes a Heart save. If it fails, it is Taunted for 1 round: its next attack must be aimed at you, if it can see you, and that attack costs it {=steps.2.numbers.attack_ap} AP more.
